name: Lost faceoff in your zone
caption: Faceoff in your zone on the {side} dot. Your center loses it cleanly back to their D at the {side} point. You lined up on the wing.

questions.prompt: The draw is lost back to their D. Tap where you go.
questions.label: On the point man

fb.right: Straight out to the D on your side, the moment the draw is lost. That shot is the whole reason they want the puck back there.
fb.close: Right direction, a few feet short. Get all the way out so his shooting lane is blocked, not just contested.
fb.wrong: When the draw is lost in your zone, the wingers go to the points immediately. The D with the puck is on your side; he is yours.

questions.prompt: The draw is lost back to their D. Tap where you go.
questions.label: Sagged, slot side

fb.right: Good. The puck went to the far point, so you sag toward the slot and keep an eye on the near D rather than racing to the puck side.
fb.close: Nearly. Hold the middle a bit more; the slot pass is the danger, and your point man is still two strides away.
fb.wrong: The puck went to the D on the far side. That is your other winger’s man. You sag into the middle, between the slot and the D on your side.

plan.label: Slot side, ready for the far point
